page.layout: One printed page, text only, with a decorative border and a large woodcut initial at the top. Heading "PROOEMIUM" centred below the border. Running text in one block below. No margin notes, no page number, no running head. Right edge of the neighbouring page shows only fragments, which are left out.

main_text.head: PROOEMIU M.
main_text.p: C[?]Anticum Canticorum explanandum suscepturus, usus sum instituto meo, ut tum ex Sacrarum Literarum fontibus ipsis, tum ex aliorum veterum & recentiorum quasi rivis haurirem quicquid ad illustrandum sensum Literalem attinere mihi videretur. Est autem in hoc Sacro dramate Literalis sensus duplex; nempe materialis, sive rei gestae inter sponsum & sponsam quae per parabolam stylo bucolico inducitur; tum etiam spiritualis quem Spiritus-Sanctus significare voluit perpetua quadam allegoria declarans mutui Christum inter & Ecclesiam amoris aculeos, locutionibus ad nostras dicendi formulas accommodatis; primus sensus dicitur grammaticalis, secundus vocatur realis; ille est cortex, hic medulla inde eruenda, nisi velimus iis esse similes, qui negligentes historiam in tabella depictam solis se coloribus oblectant, nihil in hoc Cantico Canticorum praestan-

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorated letter that is hard to identify; the reading C[?] is doubtful, and the first word may be different. The printed heading reads "PROOEMIU M." with a space before M, kept as printed. The text ends mid-word ("praestan-") and the next word is on the following page. Show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page are left out.
